items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: he didn't have the swing that men like Buster Bailey -- he knew his instrument, but he didn't have the swing.

ctx.x: In a way, but he didn't have the swing that men like Buster Bailey -- he knew his instrument, but he didn't have the swing.
See, Jimmy Harrison didn't come back with us. And I wasn't particular about Jimmy Harrison, either, because now I was thinking seriously about having a band and Jimmy didn't read well.
